title: SPOC registry projection
description: A booted SPOC registry described as data: every registered component, the three facets of its canonical identifier, where its object is defined, and its shape; plus the project's declared kind set. Describes the registry as of the completion of discovery, so components registered by a startup hook after initialization are not included.

format_version.description: The version of this document format, independent of the SPOC release that produced it. A consumer branches on this rather than on a release number.

kinds.description: The project's declared kind set, in declaration order. A kind appears here even when no component was registered under it, because 'declared and empty' and 'never declared' are different facts.

components.description: One entry per registered component, in canonical identifier order.

segment.description: One segment of a canonical identifier: lowercase snake_case, starting with a letter.

identifier.description: The canonical identifier, composed as kind:namespace.object_name.

kind.description: The identifier's kind facet. Always a member of the document's declared kind set.

namespace.description: The identifier's namespace facet, normally the app that registered the component.

location.description: Where the registered object is defined, as module:qualname. A registered instance is not itself defined anywhere, so its location names the definition site of its type. Never derived from an object's repr, which would embed a memory address and make two projections of one unchanged registry differ.

shape.description: What a consumer may do with the registered object. Constructible objects are also callable, so the vocabulary is ordered and exclusive: anything constructible is reported as such.
